body:
CDN77, an engineering-led internet infrastructure company behind some of the world’s most demanding online platforms, has signed a partnership with CVC for the next phase of its growth.

Through its long-duration investment platform, Strategic Opportunities, CVC will acquire a minority stake in CDN77. CDN77 builds and runs its own network, hardware platforms and software stack and serves some of the largest video, gaming, software and media platforms in the world. The company has grown into a global edge network of more than 230 locations around the world and 330 terabits per second of capacity.

The next phase of CDN77 will add scale to the content delivery aspect of the business and to the broader infrastructure services built around it, including storage, edge compute and dedicated CPU/GPU infrastructure for anything from low-bandwidth to bandwidth-heavy applications and AI workloads.
